shape_described: Sample shape: {shape}, excluding the batch. Training treats it as {dims}D spatial data and adds a channel. The model lists this number of dimensions, but exact sizes, channels and compatibility still need checking.
shape_mismatch: Sample shape {shape} is treated as {dims}D spatial data, excluding the batch and adding a channel. The model doesn’t list support for this number of dimensions. Review your dataset and model. This is guidance, not a compatibility check.
shape_unknown: Choose and inspect a dataset from WaveDL to check its shape. Unknown or unsupported layouts need checking before training. You can still select a model.
shape_ambiguous: Sample shape {shape}, excluding the batch, could be channel-first 2D data or a shallow 3D volume. For a single-channel volume, confirm single_channel in the training settings. Channel and training compatibility still need checking.
modelsUnavailable: The model catalogue is unavailable. Reconnect to WaveDL and try again.
connectionChanged: Connection changed. Reload the catalogue before selecting.
untranslated: This description from WaveDL isn’t available in your language yet.
